purpose: Multi-complex co-crystal redocking panel: dock each curated crystal ligand back into its frozen receptor and measure symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD vs the crystal pose.

predeclared_success_criteria.note: A complex is a per-complex PASS only if the top-docked pose (mode 1) recovers the crystal pose with heavy-atom RMSD < 2.0 A. The panel PASSES when >=70% of complexes pass AND at least one is an essential control selected for ligand/pose difficulty (see essential: true flags).

preparation_policy.receptor: crystal ATOM records, first model, altloc-filtered (mirrors prod path)
preparation_policy.ligand: crystal ligand HETATM -> obabel PDBQT with Gasteiger charges + pH 7.4 protonation (mirrors prod path)
preparation_policy.grid: fpocket pocket #1, must cover the crystal binding site (<8.0 A offset), else per-complex fail
preparation_policy.engine: AutoDock Vina (app.tools.docking.run_vina), exhaustiveness 32, num_modes 9, fixed seed
preparation_policy.rmsd: symmetry-aware heavy-atom RMSD via RDKit CalcRMS in the receptor frame without alignment; native Vina PDBQT serials mapped to the prepared reference graph using original input heavy-atom coordinates; ambiguous, missing or changed atoms fail closed. Pose SDF export validity is reported separately.

data_sourcing_note: Every complex is a real PDB co-crystal. PDB files are fetched on demand from the fixed https://files.rcsb.org/download origin (SSRF-safe) by the runner; no structure is stored in this fixture, so the fixture stays small and reproducible at run time.
limitations: Redocking exercises pose reproduction only; it does NOT measure affinity prediction accuracy, scoring function rank quality, or screening enrichment.
Crystal-ligand seeding uses the native pose as input geometry (extracted from the same PDB), which is the standard redocking setup but is more permissive than true virtual-screening blind docking.
Frozen receptor approximation ignores induced fit; flexible side-chain and ensemble docking are explicitly out of scope for this panel.
Panel execution requires the API container (AutoDock Vina + OpenBabel + fpocket). When the tools are absent the runner writes a requires_external record and never reports a pass.
correction_note: The previous nine noncanonical entries mismatched deposited ligand/protein identities. All ten PDB identifiers, essential flags, preparation policy and success thresholds are retained. Prior result records are unchanged and do not validate this corrected revision.
